prompts.meditation-ink:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: transparent decorative cultivation illustration for the existing Chinese xianxia game's main action card.
Input images:
1. Edit target: the existing adult player portrait. Preserve the same adult male identity, long dark half-tied hair and simple hairpin, ivory and muted jade robe, and restrained warm-gold detailing. Change the pose and presentation for this new sibling asset, never replace the original portrait.
2. Style reference only: the existing cave painting, for the cool jade / warm lantern-gold palette and hand-painted material quality. Do not reproduce a background landscape.
3. Composition reference only: the desktop mockup. Look only at the small ink-wash meditation illustration at the left of its lower action card. Do not reproduce any interface, lettering, number, logo, frame, panel, or icon from it.
Primary request: a single isolated full-body seated meditation vignette of this same adult player, seen from a slightly elevated rear three-quarter view, sitting cross-legged on a modest natural rock. Quiet attentive pose, relaxed sleeves, long hair draping naturally. Delicate muted jade ink washes, warm ivory robes, expressive ink edges, and a few fine luminous old-gold ribbons of breath-like mist curling around the figure. Blend the existing semi-realistic character design into a refined Chinese ink-wash illustration, detailed enough at a small game-card size. The illustration represents ordinary natural cultivation, with no weapons, magical equipment or new story characters.
Composition: square canvas, complete figure and rock contained with generous transparent margins. A compact, legible silhouette, no cropped head or hands. Sparse ink accents may dissolve toward the edges; retain clean usable alpha.
Background: genuinely transparent. No opaque paper, white rectangle, black field or simulated transparency checkerboard. The host application provides its own warm paper background.
Constraints: exactly one adult character. No text, calligraphy, seals, numerals, labels, UI, borders, watermark, new character identity, added pet, sword or relic. Do not bake any progress, price, reward or button into this artwork.
